Security/regulatory: SOC2 required, SSO via SAML, prefer KMS integration if Dedicated. Data residency: US-only for now, but EU expansion next year. Retention controls and audit logs mandatory.

Risks: potential hidden regressions (semantic drift) causing support-ticket volume spikes; engineering time to adapt compat shim if non-trivial.
Stated quote from Head of Product: "If we can hit prompt parity and show 20-30% net savings on inference, this becomes a no-brainer."
